title: Typography on the A380
slide_intent: Evaluate type on a large curved surface because the viewing angle and distance change how a word is read.
strategic_value: A strong fuselage wordmark can complement the tail symbol in recognizing Lufthansa at the gate.
demonstration: An airport photograph shows an A380 with a large Lufthansa wordmark and crane tail beside ground vehicles.
practical_value: Judge actual wordmark scale against the whole aircraft and service environment.

content_islands.name: Aircraft
content_islands.spec: Keep the wordmark and tail in one view.

content_islands.name: Ground context
content_islands.spec: Retain equipment and neighboring airport structures to establish scale.
